test_item:
Provides a unified interface (API) that translates user requests into commands to retrieve the key from the system and returns the results to the user.
(diagnostic interface handles an input parameter at the range boundary)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. ADA Active Roles permit ADA+ protected data identifiers
proc:
1. Send UDS request DiagnosticSessionControl for the SystemSupplierSpecific session
$ 10 60
2. Send UDS request ReadDataByIdentifier for DID 2966 (ECU Identity Cert Error Enable)
$ 22 29 66
er:
1. Positive response is received: 50 60
2. Positive response is received: 62 29 66 <1 byte>
